Taken together, these three factors—especially the past failure and your mother’s limited schooling—outweigh the encouraging signs such as your desire for higher education, reasonable study time, and low alcohol use, leading the model to forecast failure.

Consider asking your family for more structured academic support and using school resources to fill any gaps from earlier struggles. Small, consistent improvements in daily study habits could meaningfully change your trajectory before the final exams. (248 words)
